messages:
Maya: Quick check — we have an interactive customer demo at 11:00 PT and the plan assumed 2x A100s in eu-west1, but procurement just flagged the A100 pool as unavailable. Can we swap to 4x A10s or H100-sliced? @Zack can the vendor do a last-minute SKU swap?
Omar: 4x A10s will increase latency for the demo, but might be OK for the scripted flow. H100 slices would be closer but I need to confirm kernel/memory limits.
Priya: How long would a swap take? Demo infra is a terraform stack that provisions a dedicated pool + a NAT'd bastion. If vendor swap is slow we can try a short-lived burst pool in us-central as fallback and run the demo from there.
Zack: Talking to vendor now. Their portal shows limited H100 availability in eu-west1 but shows some ephemeral capacity via partner racks. Linking: https://vendor-status.example.com/regions/eu-west1
infra-bot: ALERT: eu-west1-a GPU pool reported capacity contention (tickets: #8765). Estimated replenishment 36-48h.
Maya: Ugh. Demo is in 2.5 hours. Customer expects sub-200ms gen for the interactivity demo. If we move to us-central, latency will be +80ms for EU clients.
Omar: We can pre-warm caches and use smaller context to shave ~30-40ms. Also can enable KV-prefix caching for demo prompts.
Priya: Ok plan proposal: 1) Try vendor partner H100 swap (Zack) 2) If not possible in 45m, provision 4x A10s in eu-west1 as temporary pool + aggressive pre-warm + reduced batch_size 3) fallback to us-central burst if both fail.
Zack: Vendor came back — partner rack can provide 2 H100 partitioned nodes but requires a 45m onboarding window (network peering + routing rules). They can expedite to 25m if we approve a quick network exception.
Maya: I can approve the network exception. Omar, can you prepare terraform diff for the A10 temp pool in case we need it ASAP? Put it in the demo stack PR and tag me.
Omar: On it. Quick terraform snippet I'll push:
```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_pool" "demo_temp" {
  region = "eu-west1"
  gpu_type = "A10"
  count = 4
  preemptible = true
}
```
Priya: Also flagging that logs/metrics retention for this pool should be minimal — we don't need full observability for a short demo. Keep costs low.
Zack: Starting vendor onboarding now. ETA 22 minutes with the exception, 40+ without. I'll update here.
infra-bot: ACTION_CREATED: network-exception-req-452 logged by Maya.
Maya: Thanks. If vendor ETA slips past 45m, proceed with A10 plan and I'll brief the customer on slight perf-risk.
Zack: Update — vendor confirmed 28m window. Proceeding with partner H100. I'll share peering details and a temporary firewall rule we need to open (tcp/4500).
Omar: I'll hold off on applying the A10 TF until Zack gives final "no-go". Standby people.
Maya: Great — appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
Priya: Noted — will prepare the fallback runbook and customer note.
Zack: Final: H100 partner nodes live in 21m. Patching routing now.
Maya: Awesome. Thanks everyone.
